title: Classification is iterative and relative; the four elements break into a 2x2 (energy source internal/external, level individual/collective) that can align with line 1 (2026-11-07)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
So. My experience of classification is that it is iterative and relative.

Also, we can try to break the 4 elements into a 2x2.

Energy source: internal/external
Level:Individual/collective

Fire is internal energy individual
Earth is external individual

Air is external collective

This can align with line 1

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-07, after the first small-model results on the Systemic Data Ethics 4x3 map (Laya at chance on level, faint on element) and on the T3 stance lines; recorded verbatim. Water is left implicit: internal energy, collective.
